title: Exploring the protective mechanisms of syringaresinol against myocardial infarction by experimental validation and network pharmacology.
authors: Feng, Lifeng; Sun, Runjia; Zhang, Hanmo; Zhang, Junwei; Peng, Zeyan; Li, Jing; Gao, Yang; Xu, Yang; Cui, Jianlin; Liu, Jie; Yan, Jie; Guo, Lihong; Yang, Liang; Shen, Yanna; Qi, Zhi
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. Molecular basis of disease
one_liner_zh: 该文研究丁香脂素对心肌梗死的保护机制，采用网络药理学和分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Myocardial Infarction (MI) is a leading cause of mortality worldwide. Currently, effective treatments are still lacking. Increasing evidence supports the benefits of Syringaresinol (SYR) for the treatment of cardiovascular disease is accumulating. Nevertheless, whether SYR can alleviate MI is unknown. The study aims to investigate the protective effect of SYR against MI and elucidate its potential molecular mechanism. We found that SYR ameliorate MI-induced cardiac dysfunction, reduce infarct size, and alleviate myocardial hypertrophy, fibrosis, inflammation, as well as apoptosis. In addition, we collected targets related to SYR and MI through multiple databases, and obtained 281 potential therapeutic targets after intersection. GO and KEGG enrichment analysis found that these therapeutic targets were concentrated on inflammation, fibrosis, and apoptosis pathways. Based on the PPI network and combined with Centiscape2.2 and cytoHubba analysis, we obtained 10 hub proteins. The molecular docking results showed that SYR has strong bindings with 10 hub proteins. snRNA-seq data showed that CASP3 and NFKB1 were expressed in all cell types. In addition, the therapeutic targets of SYR are also mainly distributed in all cell types. Finally, we found that SYR could alleviate MI by partially reversing the expression of AKT1, EGFR, CASP3, SRC, NFKB1, HSP90AA1, HIF1A, MMP9 and ESR1 both in vivo and in vitro. Our findings suggested that SYR may protect against MI by reducing inflammatory, fibrotic and apoptotic effects via multiple targets and pathways, which provides a new theoretical foundation for the clinical therapy of MI.
abstract_zh: 心肌梗死（Myocardial Infarction, MI）是全球范围内导致死亡的主要原因。目前，有效的治疗方法仍然缺乏。越来越多的证据支持丁香脂素（Syringaresinol, SYR）在治疗心血管疾病方面的益处正在积累。然而，SYR是否能缓解心肌梗死尚不清楚。本研究旨在探讨SYR对心肌梗死的保护作用，并阐明其潜在的分子机制。我们发现，SYR能改善心肌梗死引起的心脏功能障碍，减少梗死面积，并缓解心肌肥大、纤维化、炎症及细胞凋亡。此外，我们通过多个数据库收集了与SYR和心肌梗死相关的靶点，并在交集后获得了281个潜在治疗靶点。GO和KEGG富集分析发现，这些治疗靶点主要集中在炎症、纤维化和凋亡通路。基于蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络，并结合Centiscape2.2和cytoHubba分析，我们获得了10个核心蛋白。分子对接结果显示，SYR与10个核心蛋白具有强结合力。单细胞核RNA测序（snRNA-seq）数据显示，CASP3和NFKB1在所有细胞类型中均有表达。此外，SYR的治疗靶点也主要分布于所有细胞类型中。最后，我们发现SYR在体内和体外均能通过部分逆转AKT1、EGFR、CASP3、SRC、NFKB1、HSP90AA1、HIF1A、MMP9和ESR1的表达来缓解心肌梗死。我们的研究结果表明，SYR可能通过多靶点和多通路减少炎症、纤维化和凋亡效应来保护心肌免受梗死损伤，这为心肌梗死的临床治疗提供了新的理论基础。
